context:
Ruled in chat, 15:04 CDT. A build rule, not process only.

If claude-settings rules on something, it supersedes what a repo has, unless the repo explicitly carves out the rule by naming the claude-settings rule. Any guard, hook, CLAUDE.md line or other text in a child repo that conflicts with how repos inherit from claude-settings is wrong unless it cites the claude-settings rule as a "known exemption". Such text is stale prose for the compliance check to find.

Filed to roadmap step parent-rules-supersede. Decision compliance-defined is rewritten in place after batch 37 merges. First case: banchi CLAUDE.md line 350 ("The designation is never inherited"), fixed by the banchi lane.
ref: parent-rules-supersede (claude-settings rulings override child repos); decision compliance-defined (#886)
title: claude-settings rulings override a child repo unless it names a known exemption
